items.title: Witch Pouring Tea
items.alt: A silver-haired witch pours tea while a black cat watches beside a low table.
items.description: A silver-haired witch pours tea at a low round table with two cups while a seated black cat watches. Use this illustration for personal afternoon story cards, reading journals and seasonal crafts.

items.title: Witch Harvesting Herbs
items.alt: A braided witch gathers herbs beside a terracotta pot with garden shears.
items.description: A mature braided witch kneels next to a small pot containing five broad rosemary-like herb sprigs, holding three harvested sprigs and closed pruning shears. Use this illustration for personal crafts, storytelling and classroom projects.
